record.oneLiner: Pumble provides a REST API accessed via API keys generated through their API addon or custom bot tokens, with an official MCP server available.
record.verdictReason: Pumble offers a fully documented REST API authenticated via API keys that can be generated directly by workspace users and admins. Additionally, an official MCP server is provided by the vendor.

evidence.quote: Once your API addon is installed, you can generate API keys directly in Pumble.

Built on the open Model Context Protocol (MCP) standard, it lets Claude fetch live context and execute actions inside third-party apps (e.g., Pumble) without manual copy-pasting.
